metadata.title: Local Aronson-Bénilan estimates for the porous medium and fast diffusion equations on collapsing manifolds
metadata.abstract: We establish local Aronson-Bénilan estimates for positive solutions to the porous medium and fast diffusion equations on complete noncompact Riemannian manifolds with a small scale-invariant integral bound on the negative part of the Ricci curvature in $L^p$, where $p>n/2$. No uniform lower bound on the volume of unit balls is assumed, and hence the results apply to manifolds that may collapse. For the fast diffusion equation, we obtain the estimate in the range $1-2/n<m<1$. The auxiliary function method, which was designed for the heat equation under integral curvature conditions, is not directly applicable to those two nonlinear equations. The pressure operator in both cases contains a solution-dependent coefficient, which produces a residual term involving $\partial_t J$ in the evolution inequality. Its treatment requires a positive lower bound for $J$, and moreover, control of $-\partial_t\log J$. We obtain these bounds by linearizing the auxiliary equation, applying Duhamel's formula, and combining local Dirichlet heat kernel estimates with a singular Volterra inequality. Additionally, in the fast diffusion case, the negativity of $v$ changes the sign structure of the evolution inequality, so a separate coercive estimate is required to close the argument. Local Aronson-Bénilan estimates follow for both diffusion regimes and integrating them along space-time curves gives the corresponding Harnack inequalities.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 可塌缩流形上的非线性扩散梯度估计
analysis.workSummary: 在完备非紧流形上，以Ricci负部尺度不变Lp小性、p>n/2，给正多孔介质及快扩散解的局部Aronson–Bénilan估计，允许单位球体积塌缩。
techniques: 积分Ricci控制下的辅助方程
analysis.breakthrough: 处理解依赖压力算子产生的∂tJ残项，同时控制J正下界与−∂tlogJ；快扩散另用独立强制估计闭合。
analysis.limitations: 快扩散范围为1−2/n<m<1，积分曲率小性及局部参数不可省略。无体积非塌缩假设不等于无需曲率控制。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 直接联系积分曲率、塌缩与几何PDE。
